calls.title: Swag & GrowthBook Proposal Discussion
calls.summary: The discussion focused on finalizing a pricing agreement that included a three-year commitment discount of 10%, resulting in an annual price of $41,850. Bill proposed $40,000, but after discussion, he accepted the new figure to speed up the signing process. Logistics for contract signing were clarified, specifically regarding Taiwan’s tax and legal requirements, which would involve a proxy signing entity from Bill's team. The targeted timeline for contract signing is before June 30th, with James promising to send a formal pricing proposal immediately. Post-signing, the customer success team will assist with onboarding, while technical support will be available through Slack for ongoing needs. Electronic signature via DocuSign was confirmed to ensure a swift contract execution.
calls.keywords: Commitment Program, Discount Pricing, Contract Signing, Proxy Signing, Customer Success, Technical Support
